projection_rules.plain: MAIN at constant leverage L, no limits
projection_rules.capped: exposure <= $380,664 (xsec sleeve capacity $100k / w_xsec), excess capital idle at 0%
projection_rules.realistic: capped + Binance minimum orders: xsec sleeve trades only if L*w_xsec*A >= $3,000 (else that share idle at 0%); listings trades without BTC hedge while L*w_lst*A/20 < $100
projection_rules.contributions: +$100 at the end of every month (also in months with drawdowns)
projection_rules.drawdown_metrics: on the strategy NAV (time-weighted, no contributions), plain mode

capacity_notes.min_account_note: xsec sleeve needs >= ~$3k of its own notional (min order $5, BTC $100, ETH $20); listings BTC hedge needs >= $100 per trade (sleeve >= ~$2k at K=20)
